# Atlas physical map source

`ne_110m_land.geojson` comes from the Natural Earth Vector repository's
1:110m physical land dataset:

- https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector
- https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/110m-land/

Natural Earth data is public domain. This physical layer contains land and
coastline geometry only; it intentionally does not include administrative or
political boundary layers.
